blocks.text: A court in Lanao del Sur has ordered the arrest of lawyer Levito Baligod and the 18 witnesses under his watch for cyberlibel charges filed by a lawmaker. According to the arrest warrant issued by Presiding Judge Samina Sampaco Macabando-Usman of Branch 8 of the Marawi City Regional Trial Court, bail was set at P30,000
